name: augi-ui
description: augi-ui, the OpenAugi pane beside your agent chat: anchor on a Kanban project or task, pin its context (notes, sessions, artifacts, links), run lenses, and keep its Agent Log of context, questions, chats and saved notes. Drafts only; you press enter.

notesFolder.title: Notes folder
notesFolder.description: The folder that holds your markdown notes (an Obsidian vault or any folder). An absolute path; ~ is allowed.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: What opens a note when you press it in the pane. custom uses the command below.

editorCommand.title: Custom editor command
editorCommand.description: Used when the editor is custom. {file} is replaced by the note's path, e.g. zed {file}.

contextNote.title: Context note
contextNote.description: Who you are, your season focus and your projects, inside the notes folder. The first bold line under a heading with 'season' or 'focus' becomes your focus line.

boardNote.title: Board note
boardNote.description: A Kanban-style board inside the notes folder. Each open card that links a note can be your anchor.

lensFolder.title: Lens folder
lensFolder.description: A folder of lens notes inside the notes folder: one markdown prompt per lens.

logFolder.title: Agent log folder
logFolder.description: Where Augi keeps one Agent Log per anchor: the companion note agents write (context, questions, chats, saved notes). Your own note is never written.

taskFolder.title: Task folder
taskFolder.description: Where a new task note from the pane goes, inside the notes folder. Empty puts it beside the current anchor's note, or at the notes folder's root.

lensPicks.title: Lens picks
lensPicks.description: Lens names to show, comma separated, in this order. Empty shows every lens in the lens folder.
